objective: Validate the two Harness failure classes observed by the fixed R149 live diagnostic without rerunning or completing the 30-question cohort.

hypotheses.ledger_isolation: Four concurrent processes using four configured shard ledgers complete and maintain four distinct global budget indexes; a configuration that reuses one authority is rejected before execution.
hypotheses.planner_timeout: Three fixed live planner calls complete under the explicit 180-second per-attempt transport bound with cost, latency, trajectory, and termination evidence.

sample_size.rationale: These are mechanism probes, not an effectiveness estimate. Four processes exercise the cross-shard collision surface, while three planner calls match the three consecutive 60-second attempt failures observed on Q13.

noise.measured: Pass/fail is based on process exit, distinct authority paths, bounded termination, and offline-verifiable trajectories; latency and cost are recorded but are not used to infer finance quality.
noise.decision_rule: Pass only if 4/4 isolated ledger processes succeed, the duplicate-authority negative control is rejected, and 3/3 live planner calls complete under the registered 180-second role bound with complete trajectory evidence.

stop_conditions: a fourth live planner call would be required
a probe would mutate a remote provider or rerun a golden-set question
rollback: Do not publish the reliability proof; retain all raw failures and continue F02-F10 work that does not depend on the failed mechanism. No golden-set result is replaced or supplemented.
